title: The House Ra ring — blind reading
origin: Independent challenge by AUSGANG LAB; not affiliated with original creator or BTCX repository
goal: Test whether unrelated readers applying a frozen 60-position glyph key to the film-370 House Ra seal report reproducible numeric sequences; not a language translation or decryption.

calibration.numbering: 60 glyphs: six rows of nine and a right-aligned last row of six; 0–59 left-to-right, top-to-bottom

challenge.target: House Ra circular seal in opening frame
requirements: Freeze exact frame, ring band, start position, direction, unreadable glyph policy
Record glyph string with '?' for uncertain positions
Then map to 0–59, without retroactive fixes
Count repeated ring copies as one design
Report contradictions and independent second tests
Two runs of the same AI model are not automatically independent
challenge.uncertainty_stop_rule: Mark inconclusive if count of ? divided by all recorded glyph positions exceeds 10%. A ? does not count as agreement. Heuristic, not significance test.

privacy: Do not post secrets, personal or confidential data, executable files, bypass instructions or copyrighted third-party screenshots.
